movement.note: our own number's open->close movement. It is not market movement: no market price exists in this repository. Every market_* column is blank and flagged.

store.definition: open = fit on weeks before the game's week; close = fit on every final dated before that game's kickoff. For a played game both exist; for an unplayed game the close is PENDING and stays blank.

sources.market_probe_finding: the official game centre for LAC@BAL week 10 shows participation, team stats and standings; it publishes no odds, spread, total or moneyline

limits: Every market column is blank: no official NFL price publication exists (verified 2026-11-14 on the LAC@BAL game centre).
One season of results, so sigma and the ratings are fitted on at most 137 games.
The moneyline inherits the side model's error by construction.
